description: 경상남도_재난대피시설 [disaster risk and hazard maps] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 경상남도. 경상남도 재난대피시설의 명칭, 내용, 작성자 등을 조회하는 경상남도 재난대피시설 정보 조회 서비스. Coverage: 경상남도. The portal files it under the publisher 경상남도. Its tags are 재난, 대피, 시설, 재난안전. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2020-08-07 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
